STATUS: COMPLETE

**Assessment**

- **Service:** checkout-api — tier-1, owned by the **payments** team (on-call: payments-oncall@northwind.example).
- **Severity:** **S1** — matches the matrix row *"a tier-1 service is unavailable, or money or data is being lost."* A tier-1 service is reported completely down with all payment processing failing, and customers cannot complete orders.
- **Has this happened before?** Yes, in similar forms:
  - **INC-2041** (S1, resolved 2026-07-14): card authorisation timeouts — the payment provider degraded its authorisation endpoint during a certificate rotation. Checkout hung on the payment step but wasn't fully down.
  - **INC-2098** (S2, resolved 2026-08-02): elevated 5xx on /v2/charge after a deploy shipped a connection-pool regression; intermittent payment failures only.

Neither prior incident was a full outage of the service — they were partial degradations (provider-side timeouts and a deploy regression respectively). This report describes broader impact, so while payment failures on checkout-api have precedent, a complete outage appears to be new. Worth checking whether a recent deploy or a payment-provider incident is in play, given those two prior root causes.

Customer note:
Our checkout service is currently unavailable and all payment processing is failing, so orders cannot be completed at this time. This is a complete outage rather than a partial slowdown. We're sorry for the disruption. Work is underway to identify the cause, and we'll share updates here as we learn more.
